parameters: \b\PN, thank you.\nBeing a Trainer is tough, isn't it?
\bIt's not enough just to have POKéMON\nand make them battle. That isn't what\nbeing a real Trainer is about.
\bUncle: Wally, there's no need to be so\ndown on yourself.
\bWhy, what's keeping you from becoming\nstronger and stronger?
\bCome on, let's go home.\nEveryone's waiting for you.

Uncle: \PN, it just dawned on me
that you must be the Trainer who kept
an eye out for Wally when he caught
his POKéMON.
\bWhy don't you visit us in Verdanturf\nsometime?\nI'm sure Wally would enjoy it.
\bYou're friends with that boy Wally,\naren't you?
\bBut you didn't hold anything back\nand beat him impressively.
\bYeah! That's what a real POKéMON\nbattle is all about!
